Company profile

Rosenbauer is a leading global provider of firefighting technology and has stood for innovation, quality and safety for 160 years. Our group combines tradition with technological excellence and is shaping the future of firefighting.

Learn more
Global partner for firefighting technology for 160 years

Fire service equipment supplier with international format

Rosenbauer is an international corporation and a reliable partner to fire departments around the world. The company develops and produces vehicles, firefighting and safety equipment, and digital solutions for professional, in-house, plant and voluntary fire departments, as well as systems for preventative fire protection. Products fabrication in Europe, the US and Asia cover all important standards. With sales of €1.429,0 million, around 4,900 employees (as of December 31, 2025) and a sales and service network in approximately 110 countries, the Group is the largest fighting equipment supplier in the world.

The listed company has been serving fire departments for 160 years. Customer focus, innovative strength, and reliability are Rosenbauer's core strengths.

Rosenbauer City 2030

Strategy 2030: Innovation for the future of firefighting

With the Strategy 2030, Rosenbauer wants to change the world of firefighting. Rosenbauer relies on innovation and technology leadership, customer loyalty and operational excellence.

Learn more about the strategy (Opens in new tab)

Strategy 2030

Rosenbauer strives for the top position in all areas. The company's primary goal is to achieve sustainable, profitable growth and thus continuously increase the value of the company.

In implementation this leadership claim, Rosenbauer benefits from the strengths of the company as a whole: 

  • from its traditional pulley as an innovation and technology leader,
  • from the global reputation of the Rosenbauer brand,
  • from motivated and high-performing employees, and
  • from its global presence as a full-service provider of firefighting vehicles, extinguishing systems, equipment , and customized services.

Sustainability responsibility

Rosenbauer nimmt im Sinne eines zukunftsorientierten Konzerns seine Nachhaltigkeitsverantwortung aktiv wahr und achtet gleichermaßen auf Gesellschaft sowie Umwelt. The entire group is aligned with the principle of sustainability. This is the foundation of all social activities and the basis of entrepreneurial action. By pooling resources, priorities are set in the areas of education & youth, fire services and regionality. A careful approach to nature and compliance with all laws are a matter of course.

Learn more

Code of Conduct - Integrity

Compliance at Rosenbauer means adhering to legal provisions and regulatory standards, including the ethical standards and requirements set by the company itself.
 
Compliance is an essential component of integrity and thus an unshakable cornerstone of Rosenbauer's business. Wherever the company operates, local laws and its own regulations – above all the Rosenbauer Code of Conduct – must be strictly followed.
 
The Code of Conduct sets out principles of conduct that are binding for all employees of the Group. Responsible and lawful conduct is a fundamental prerequisite for Rosenbauer 's success and has a decisive influence on the reputation of the entire Group. Rosenbauer strives for exemplary quality not only in its products and processes, but also in its behavior toward third parties.

quality, enviroment and safety

Rosenbauer supports fire departments in their responsible work with firefighting equipment that functions reliably for years and decades. The Group therefore sustainably ensures the quality of its products and processes through an integrated management system. The ISO-certified management system is implemented as a dynamic process at Rosenbauer .
